input.command:
python3 -c "
import torch
for i in [1, 2]:
    d = torch.device(f'cuda:{i}')
    torch.cuda.set_device(d)
    torch.cuda.empty_cache()
    torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats(d)
    # Force a small allocation to kick the driver
    x = torch.zeros(1, device=d)
    del x
    torch.cuda.synchronize(d)
print('CUDA reset done for GPU 1 and 2')
"
